fontProvenance: Installed Arial and Apple Color Emoji. Native PDF contains font subsets; this does not qualify other installations or scripts.
reproduction: Generate IWorkPagesParagraphWritingTests.Example(); decode with verify-pages-creation.py and the pinned descriptor. Open a working copy in Pages, change the final paragraph, save, close/reopen and export PDF/Word. Run extract-pages-native-layout.py against the Apple-saved source and Word export. Convert the saved source through WordIWorkConverter in EditableOnly mode, save/reopen DOCX, then import that DOCX in Pages and compare every PDF word bound.
boundaries: The creation profile remains left-aligned with zero indents, a 36-point default tab interval and no leaders. Public rich-run constructors reject TAB; the plain layout overload authors TAB text.

Custom native layout uses a period decimal symbol. The reader retains explicit period/comma values. Uniform active DOCX decimal symbols map to one document setting; heterogeneous specified/unspecified symbols require fallback. PPTX separator metadata requires explicit partial acceptance.

The writer does not measure pagination or embed fonts. Additional producers, fonts, scripts, paragraph locales, lists, tables, images, headers/footers, section layouts and loaded-source semantic editing require their own qualification.
The final LF projects an extra empty paragraph; Apple Word exports the seven authored paragraphs.
Pages 15.4 DOCX import does not produce equivalent decimal-tab placement for this fixture despite an explicit period setting; the discrepancy remains recorded in the product roadmap.
